subject.title: fix(cron): queued jobs are lost after Gateway restart

question: Do maintainers approve the compatibility policy of replaying newly persisted queued reservations after restart while continuing to conservatively interrupt legacy `runningAtMs` rows?
rationale: This is a deliberate recovery contract for persisted scheduler state: choosing a more aggressive legacy replay policy could duplicate external side effects, while a more conservative policy can preserve historical interruption behavior.

options.title: Approve the split recovery policy
options.body: Keep queued reservations restart-recoverable and retain conservative handling for legacy active markers, provided the refreshed merge head preserves the tested behavior.

options.title: Require a different legacy migration policy
options.body: Pause for an explicit upgrade design if maintainers want legacy rows to distinguish queued from active work rather than preserving conservative interruption handling.

recommendation.title: Approve the split recovery policy
recommendation.body: Keep queued reservations restart-recoverable and retain conservative handling for legacy active markers, provided the refreshed merge head preserves the tested behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the current recovery design and its focused validation, making them the best available routing contact for the technical contract discussion.
